Microsoft.summary:

Antipodes Global Fund stated the following regarding Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) in its Q3 2026 investor letter: "Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) finished higher over the Quarter following another robust earnings result, with Azure growth accelerating on sustained enterprise AI adoption and expanding Copilot deployments.
While we acknowledge the risk and potential of Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) as an investment, we believe certain AI infrastructure stocks offer far stronger long-term potential at a much more attractive entry point.

Microsoft.title: Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees amid AI investments - SiliconANGLE
Microsoft.titleEn: Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees amid AI investments - SiliconANGLE
Microsoft.titleKo: 마이크로소프트, AI 투자 속 직원 6만 명에 자발적 인수 제안 - SiliconANGLE
Microsoft.summary:
After the company let go 1,600 of the division’s employees in June, GeekWire reported that additional layoffs were expected.
Microsoft will also provide stock vesting for six to 12 months, continued healthcare coverage for a limited amount of time and outplacement support.
Microsoft’s revenue grew 18% year-over-year in the three months ended June, to $90.01 billion, while its adjusted earnings of $4.74 per share topped the consensus estimate by more than 12%.

Microsoft.title: Scale reservoir uncertainty analysis with agile reservoir modeling | Microsoft Azure Blog
Microsoft.titleEn: Scale reservoir uncertainty analysis with agile reservoir modeling | Microsoft Azure Blog
Microsoft.titleKo: 민첩한 저수지 모델링을 통한 규모 저수지 불확실성 분석 | 마이크로소프트 애저 블로그
Microsoft.summary:
For reservoir engineers and asset teams, ARM turns ensemble modeling into a repeatable workflow rather than a bespoke infrastructure project.
The industry has long recognized the value of ensemble modeling for risk-aware decision-making, but adoption has been constrained by infrastructure and software designed for smaller, sequential studies.
Scale reservoir uncertainty analysis with agile reservoir modeling Turn subsurface uncertainty into decision-ready insight Drilling campaigns are among the most expensive and operationally complex activities in the energy industry.

NVIDIA.title: Oracle, in effort to reduce reliance on Nvidia, adds AI chips from Google, Cerebras, and SambaNova
NVIDIA.titleEn: Oracle, in effort to reduce reliance on Nvidia, adds AI chips from Google, Cerebras, and SambaNova
NVIDIA.titleKo: Oracle은 Nvidia에 대한 의존도를 줄이기 위해 Google, Cerebras 및 SambaNova의 AI 칩을 추가함
NVIDIA.summary:
Cerebras's massive chips will provide AI inference capacity and AI agent processing power, while SambaNova's SN50 processor will handle agentic inference.
Oracle said its decision to bring on Google, Cerebras, and SambaNova's processors provides its customers with the right infrastructure for their particular needs.
Nvidia has previously said it generates roughly half of its revenue from hyperscalers, making Google's move and Amazon's potential efforts of particular concern for the company.

오라클은 Google, Cerebras 및 SambaNova의 프로세서를 도입하기로 한 결정이 고객의 특정 요구에 맞는 인프라를 제공한다고 말함

NVIDIA.title: How AI Is Changing the Pace of Discovery for Millions Living With Dementia
NVIDIA.titleEn: How AI Is Changing the Pace of Discovery for Millions Living With Dementia
NVIDIA.titleKo: AI가 치매를 앓고 있는 수백만 명의 발견 속도를 어떻게 변화시키는가
NVIDIA.summary:
There are 57 million people worldwide living with dementia today.
To explore how AI and accelerated computing can advance Alzheimer’s research while navigating its technical demands, C-BRAIN is working with NVIDIA to incorporate technologies including the NVIDIA BioNeMo open developer platform and the MONAI framework for C-BRAIN’s research pipelines.
The bottlenecks are not enough high impact scientific findings, too much data living in institutional silos and too slow a pace of synthesis to keep up with the research that is published.

summaryLinesKo: 오늘날 전 세계적으로 5,700만 명이 치매를 앓고 있음
C-BRAIN은 AI와 가속 컴퓨팅이 알츠하이머 연구를 발전시키는 동시에 기술적 요구 사항을 충족할 수 있는 방법을 탐색하기 위해 NVIDIA와 협력하여 C-BRAIN의 연구 파이프라인을 위한 NVIDIA BioNeMo 개방형 개발자 플랫폼 및 MONAI 프레임워크를 포함한 기술을 통합하고 있음
병목 현상은 영향력이 큰 과학적 연구 결과가 충분하지 않고, 기관의 사일로에 너무 많은 데이터가 존재하며, 발표된 연구를 따라잡기에는 너무 느린 합성 속도로 인해 발생함

NVIDIA.title: Nvidia, AMD to invest $4 billion in Meta as tech giants deepen AI partnership
NVIDIA.titleEn: Nvidia, AMD to invest $4 billion in Meta as tech giants deepen AI partnership
NVIDIA.titleKo: Nvidia, AMD, 거대 기술 기업들이 AI 파트너십을 심화함에 따라 Meta에 40억 달러 투자
NVIDIA.summary:
Nvidia and AMD have said they will invest $3 billion and $1 billion, respectively, in Meta.
Nvidia announced its investment on Tuesday, adding that Meta would expand Vera Rubin and Vera CPU deployment, and that the two companies would deepen their partnership on Muse, the social media giant's AI agent that launched last month.
Meta on Monday announced plans to raise a total of $95 billion to support its investments in artificial intelligence infrastructure.

Nvidia는 화요일에 투자를 발표하면서 Meta가 Vera Rubin 및 Vera CPU 배포를 확대할 것이며 두 회사가 지난달 출시된 소셜 미디어 거대 기업의 AI 에이전트인 Muse에 대한 파트너십을 심화할 것이라고 덧붙였음

NVIDIA.title: Nvidia open-sources Flora to make robot video labeling 125x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra
NVIDIA.titleEn: Nvidia open-sources Flora to make robot video labeling 125x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra
NVIDIA.titleKo: Nvidia는 Flora를 오픈소스화하여 로봇 비디오 라벨링을 GPT-6 Astra보다 125배 저렴하게 만듬
NVIDIA.summary:
Labeling one hour of robot video for 72 cents instead of $88 is what Nvidia promises with Flora, its open data engine.
Claude Opus 5 scored much worse in the same test and still cost about $42 per hour.
In a test with 50 videos, Flora scored slightly better than GPT-6 Astra according to Nvidia, even though OpenAI's model was allowed to use its full reasoning capacity.

The company aims to have more than 3,500 robotaxis operating in over 20 cities worldwide by the end of 2026, up from a fleet of 1,975 vehicles at the end of June.

NVIDIA.title: Using AI Agents to Teach Robots Like Microduck to Walk in Simulation | NVIDIA Technical Blog
NVIDIA.titleEn: Using AI Agents to Teach Robots Like Microduck to Walk in Simulation | NVIDIA Technical Blog
NVIDIA.titleKo: AI 에이전트를 사용하여 Microduck과 같은 로봇에게 시뮬레이션 걷기 교육 | NVIDIA 기술 블로그
NVIDIA.summary:
NVIDIA RTX Spark serves as a local development hub where AI agents such as Hermes and Nemotron 3.5 Bolt translate a prompt into a step-by-step project plan for a simulated Microduck obstacle course.
Newton , an open-source, GPU-accelerated physics engine, simulates how Microduck moves and interacts with the ground and its environment in response to those actions.
Using the project plan and references from the previous stage, Astra creates the 3D assets needed for the course.
summaryLinesEn: NVIDIA RTX Spark serves as a local development hub where AI agents such as Hermes and Nemotron 3.5 Bolt translate a prompt into a step-by-step project plan for a simulated Microduck obstacle course.

Using the project plan and references from the previous stage, Astra creates the 3D assets needed for the course.
summaryLinesKo: NVIDIA RTX Spark는 Hermes 및 Nemotron 3.5 Bolt와 같은 AI 에이전트가 시뮬레이션된 Microduck 장애물 코스를 위한 단계별 프로젝트 계획으로 프롬프트를 변환하는 로컬 개발 허브 역할을 함
오픈 소스 GPU 가속 물리 엔진인 Newton은 Microduck이 이러한 동작에 반응하여 땅과 주변 환경을 움직이고 상호 작용하는 방식을 시뮬레이션함
Astra는 이전 단계의 프로젝트 계획과 참고 자료를 사용하여 과정에 필요한 3D 자산을 만듬

NVIDIA.titleKo: NVIDIA 개방형 모델은 유럽 공공 부문 프로젝트의 새로운 물결을 주도함
NVIDIA.summary:
That includes Nemotron-Personas-Germany, an open dataset of 1 million records, each with six synthetic personas, grounded in the 2022 census across all 16 federal states and 400 districts.
The planned offering combines four components: NVIDIA accelerated computing and NVIDIA Nemotron open models; Red Hat OpenShift AI for deploying and managing AI workloads; deepset’s Haystack AI agent orchestration; and infrastructure operated by secunet in German data centers.
To support local development, the Sovereign Open Source Foundation Models research initiative (Soofi) is developing a family of AI models for German industry and the public sector.

Apple.title: Apple Creator Studio update adds MotionVFX to Final Cut, and AI to everywhere - Engadget
Apple.titleEn: Apple Creator Studio update adds MotionVFX to Final Cut, and AI to everywhere - Engadget
Apple.titleKo: Apple Creator Studio 업데이트로 Final Cut에 MotionVFX, 모든 곳에 AI 추가 - Engadget
Apple.summary:
Apple Creator Studio costs $13 per month or $129 per year, and any new subscriber can try it out first with a one-month free trial.
There are plenty of other smaller quality-of-life additions for creators, like additional keyframe easing options in Final Cut Pro and the ability to isolate or swap out drum parts with the Stem Splitter in Logic Pro.
Some Final Cut Pro features require Apple silicon to work, and any Mac running the Apple Creator Studio version of the program needs to be running on macOS 26.6 or later.

Apple.title: Apple's iMac with M6 arrives promising a 'huge leap' in AI performance - Engadget
Apple.titleEn: Apple's iMac with M6 arrives promising a 'huge leap' in AI performance - Engadget
Apple.summary:
Since it's mainly designed for productivity, Apple says the iMac is up to 50 percent faster for tasks like Microsoft Excel compared to the iMac M4, or 2.5x faster than the M1 model.
That processor, along with faster 170GB/s memory bandwidth, will make the iMac twice as fast for graphics performance compared to the previous iMac M4 model, accelerating intensive tasks like photo editing and gaming, Apple said.
Unlike the latest Mac Studio, it only supports Thunderbolt 4 rather than the two-times-faster Thunderbolt 5 connections, unfortunately.

It will begin arriving to customers, and in Apple Store locations and Apple Authorized Resellers, starting Friday, November 6. iMac with M6 featuring a 10-core CPU and 10-core GPU starts at $1,499 (U.S.) and $1,449 (U.S.) with education savings . iMac with a 12-core CPU and 12-core GPU starts at $1,699 (U.S.) and $1,599 (U.S.) with education savings .
Industry-leading camera and audio : A 12MP Center Stage camera helps keep users perfectly framed on video calls, while Desk View enables them to share a top-down view of their workspace — ideal for educators giving lessons or creatives showing off their latest project. iMac also brings incredible audio to any space.
Up to 2.5x faster performance in apps like Microsoft Excel, compared to iMac with M1, 1 and up to 1.5x faster performance than M4, so families, aspiring creators, and small businesses can fly through daily productivity tasks.

Google DeepMind.summary:
Tim Rocktäschel co-founded Recursive , now valued at $4.65 billion.
He then moved to Deepmind, where he worked on AlphaGo , AlphaZero , and MuZero .
Hallucinations come from the training process itself , the paper argues, because models learn to produce plausible text rather than true text, and even the chains of thought in today's reasoning models often fail to show how an answer was actually reached.

Google DeepMind.title: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation
Google DeepMind.titleEn: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation
Google DeepMind.summary:
We have started rolling Genie 4 out as a research preview for trusted testers — gathering feedback before we release it to consumers and developers, starting with Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie and early access partners of the Gemini API and Google AI Studio.
The Genie 4 model incorporates and builds on capabilities from the Gemini family: Gemini Omni anchors the simulations in real-world appearance and behavior, while other Gemini models provide the complex reasoning needed to help maintain a simulation’s coherence and continuity.
Today, we are announcing Genie 4, our new world model, which unlocks unprecedented realism and improves real-time interactive simulation.

Currently topping the chart is Claude Sonnet 5.5, with a pass rate of 40% and a completion rate of 80.9%.
The Android Bench was introduced early this year as a way for Android developers to get a quick way to see what AI models were best suited to Android coding assistance based on a test from Google.

Amazon.titleEn: Exowatt beats frontier models on accuracy with SageMaker serverless model customization | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleKo: Exowatt는 SageMaker 서버리스 모델 사용자 정의를 통해 정확도 면에서 최첨단 모델을 능가합니다 | 아마존 웹 서비스
Amazon.summary:
Training completed in about 32 minutes on SageMaker serverless fine-tuning for roughly $20–$25.
They then expanded the training set to 86,281 rows by having Anthropic’s Claude Sonnet 4.6 on Amazon Bedrock rewrite the prose of each example while its labels and numeric fields stayed fixed.
The pipeline produces task-specific fine-tuned models for two deployment targets, edge and cloud, achieving higher accuracy than frontier models at up to 49× lower cost.

그런 다음 Anthropic의 Amazon Bedrock에 있는 Claude Sonnet 4.6이 레이블과 숫자 필드를 고정한 상태에서 각 예의 산문을 다시 작성하도록 하여 훈련 세트를 86,281개 행으로 확장함

Amazon.title: Fix evaluation bias to unlock better models on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleEn: Fix evaluation bias to unlock better models on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleKo: Amazon Bedrock에서 더 나은 모델을 잠금 해제하기 위해 평가 편향 수정 | 아마존 웹 서비스
Amazon.summary:
The engineering team at Property Finder , a digital real estate application, discovered that 96.8 percent of their evaluation labels had been inherited directly from a single model’s predictions rather than verified by human experts.
In the remaining 3.2 percent of human-labeled samples, annotators had introduced categories outside the original specification, like Office appearing where no such label existed in the prompt.
In this post, we share how Property Finder identified evaluation bias, built unbiased ground truth, and applied evolutionary prompt optimization to select the right model on Amazon Bedrock, achieving higher accuracy at 86 percent lower cost.
summaryLinesEn: The engineering team at Property Finder , a digital real estate application, discovered that 96.8 percent of their evaluation labels had been inherited directly from a single model’s predictions rather than verified by human experts.
In the remaining 3.2 percent of human-labeled samples, annotators had introduced categories outside the original specification, like Office appearing where no such label existed in the prompt.

In this post, we share how Property Finder identified evaluation bias, built unbiased ground truth, and applied evolutionary prompt optimization to select the right model on Amazon Bedrock, achieving higher accuracy at 86 percent lower cost.
summaryLinesKo: 디지털 부동산 애플리케이션인 Property Finder의 엔지니어링 팀은 평가 라벨의 96.8%가 인간 전문가의 검증이 아닌 단일 모델의 예측에서 직접 상속되었다는 사실을 발견함
사람이 레이블을 지정한 나머지 3.2%의 샘플에서는 주석 작성자가 프롬프트에 해당 레이블이 없는 곳에 Office가 나타나는 것과 같이 원래 사양을 벗어난 범주를 도입함
이 게시물에서는 Property Finder가 어떻게 평가 편향을 식별하고, 편향되지 않은 실측 정보를 구축하고, 혁신적인 프롬프트 최적화를 적용하여 Amazon Bedrock에서 올바른 모델을 선택하여 86% 더 낮은 비용으로 더 높은 정확도를 달성했는지 공유함

Amazon.summary:
As we show in the What we measured section, this reduced GPU idle time during image pulls by up to 90 percent in our benchmarks.
SOCI-indexed images start Amazon SageMaker AI training containers in seconds, with no impact on training performance.
The impact is largest exactly where iteration speed matters most: hyperparameter tuning sweeps for hundreds of jobs, quick experiments, and short processing jobs, where image download can dominate total runtime.

This solution ships two Amazon CloudWatch dashboards spanning seven layers of telemetry, plus two forms of evaluation, on-demand and continuous, from the same deployment.

Anthropic.title: Claude discovers a novel enzyme system
Anthropic.titleEn: Claude discovers a novel enzyme system
Anthropic.summary:
After 21 hours spent searching this data by roughly 950 agents using 210 million tokens, one of the agents spotted something remarkable: a repeating pattern of DNA sequences that occurs next to the gene for an odd-looking RT.
Our research prior to joining Anthropic has helped to better understand the evolution and regulation of CRISPR systems, discover new enzymes for next-generation cell and gene therapies , and build tools for accelerating the identification of anomalies in DNA, such as human pathogenic variants.
We do research that involves only the lower levels of the biosafety risk level (BSL-1 and BSL-2) and we do not handle pathogens that can infect humans.

Anthropic.title: Discovering and exploiting vulnerabilities in critical, real-world software with Claude
Anthropic.titleEn: Discovering and exploiting vulnerabilities in critical, real-world software with Claude
Anthropic.titleKo: Claude와 함께 중요한 실제 소프트웨어의 취약점을 발견하고 활용함
Anthropic.summary:
In this post, we share details of five attack chains, which led to remote code execution and other critical impacts with little to no user interaction.
When we asked Claude to identify potentially higher-risk issues, it surfaced this remotely exploitable vulnerability.
Over the past few months, we’ve used an unreleased, internal research model to find critical vulnerabilities in some of the world’s most widely used software, such as browsers and operating systems.

Anthropic.title: Early progress on accelerating drug development with Claude
Anthropic.titleEn: Early progress on accelerating drug development with Claude
Anthropic.titleKo: Claude와 함께 신약 개발 가속화의 조기 진전
Anthropic.summary:
BMS is using Claude to assess plans of an early-stage drug in clinical trials, and to estimate the likelihood of those trials succeeding.
We’ve also recently launched an open call for guest investigators in the life sciences; we’re seeking proposals from research groups who want to use Claude to investigate key questions in drug discovery and other areas.
If Claude is to significantly increase the rate of new cures, we need to work with many more biotechnology firms and integrate Claude more deeply into their development processes.

Anthropic.titleEn: Expanding our partnership with GSA to bring Claude to all levels of government
Anthropic.titleKo: Claude를 모든 수준의 정부에 제공하기 위해 GSA와의 파트너십 확장
Anthropic.summary:
Weekly Claude for Government active users are up about eightfold since February, and usage across federal civilian agencies has grown about 20-fold in a year.
A US state IT developer moved nearly 900 API methods to a new framework in two days.
We are also launching a dedicated program to help agencies implement and make the most of their Claude use.

Anthropic.title: How AI agents shape experts’ judgment calls
Anthropic.titleEn: How AI agents shape experts’ judgment calls
Anthropic.titleKo: AI 에이전트가 전문가의 판단 결정을 내리는 방법
Anthropic.summary:
On each of the four analytical decisions, analysts’ choices matched their agents’ lean the large majority of the time: 92% for the outcome measure, 82% for the comparison method, 81% for which farms the estimate covered, and 90% for weighting.
Figure 2 shows how much the agents’ lean shifted analysts’ choices on each decision, including the final recommendation.
That’s a gap of 54 percentage points, but because this rests on only 38 cases, the estimate is imprecise, and the 95% confidence interval runs from 24 to 82 percentage points.

Anthropic.title: The Anthropic S-1 Filing Is Also an AI Doomsday Primer
Anthropic.titleEn: The Anthropic S-1 Filing Is Also an AI Doomsday Primer
Anthropic.titleKo: 인류의 S-1 제출은 AI 최후의 심판의 입문서이기도 함
Anthropic.summary:
Or, as the Anthropic filing puts it: “Risks will increase as AI systems substantially automate AI research and development if, for example, they accelerate AI progress beyond our ability to evaluate and safeguard new models.”
While the prospectus contains the eye-popping revenue—and even larger expenditures—you might expect, the biggest section of the filing by far is given over to “risk factors,” which are all the things that could squash Anthropic’s big plans.
AI already plays a big role here—and at least one lab has used something close to RSI to speed up development on a model that punches above its weights —but the scenario that sparks doomsday talk is one in which humans are no longer in the loop at all.

OpenAI.summary:
Nvidia CEO plays with adorable Microduck robots, 20,000 sell Julie Bort Warhound raises $200M to engineer war dogs and arm them with Anduril gear Dominic-Madori Davis Uber puts all 30,000 employees on ChatGPT Work Lucas Ropek
The suit joins a line of cases against OpenAI that include the August 2025 lawsuit brought by the parents of 16-year-old Adam Raine, which alleged OpenAI prioritized engagement over user safety .
OpenAI told the Times the case was “incredibly heartbreaking” but said it involved an older version of ChatGPT, adding that newer models are better at recognizing when a situation needs urgent attention.

OpenAI.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra for faster, better performing AI agents at half the price - SiliconANGLE
OpenAI.titleEn: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra for faster, better performing AI agents at half the price - SiliconANGLE
OpenAI.titleKo: OpenAI, 절반 가격으로 더 빠르고 더 나은 성능의 AI 에이전트를 위한 GPT-6.1 Terra 출시 - SiliconANGLE
OpenAI.summary:
On the Terminal-Bench 4.0 test, which measures coding agents on tasks done through a computer’s command-line terminal, it solved 50.3% of all tasks when using maximum reasoning effort, up from 21.5% with GPT-5.6 Terra.
The new model is the successor to GTP-5.6 Terra and is said to cost around 50% less while handling computer use tasks faster and with greater accuracy.
GPT-6.1 Terra understands what’s on screen, takes action across apps, writes naturally, and is a more capable model for your whole workday with the efficiency to take on more of it. pic.twitter.com/8JTN1yonmV OpenAI said the model is available now for all ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu users in ChatGPT Work and Codex.
summaryLinesEn: On the Terminal-Bench 4.0 test, which measures coding agents on tasks done through a computer’s command-line terminal, it solved 50.3% of all tasks when using maximum reasoning effort, up from 21.5% with GPT-5.6 Terra.
The new model is the successor to GTP-5.6 Terra and is said to cost around 50% less while handling computer use tasks faster and with greater accuracy.

GPT-6.1 Terra understands what’s on screen, takes action across apps, writes naturally, and is a more capable model for your whole workday with the efficiency to take on more of it. pic.twitter.com/8JTN1yonmV OpenAI said the model is available now for all ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu users in ChatGPT Work and Codex.
summaryLinesKo: 컴퓨터의 명령줄 터미널을 통해 수행되는 작업에 대한 코딩 에이전트를 측정하는 Terminal-Bench 4.0 테스트에서 최대 추론 노력을 사용할 때 모든 작업의 50.3%를 해결했으며 이는 GPT-5.6 Terra의 21.5%에서 증가한 것임
새로운 모델은 GTP-5.6 Terra의 후속 모델로 컴퓨터 사용 작업을 더 빠르고 정확하게 처리하면서 비용은 약 50% 저렴하다고 함

GPT-6.1 Terra는 화면에 표시된 내용을 이해하고, 여러 앱에서 작업을 수행하고, 자연스럽게 글을 쓰며, 더 많은 작업을 수행할 수 있는 효율성을 갖춘 전체 업무 시간에 더 유능한 모델임 · pic.twitter.com/8JTN1yonmV OpenAI는 이제 ChatGPT Work 및 Codex의 모든 ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Enterprise 및 Edu 사용자가 이 모델을 사용할 수 있다고 말함

OpenAI.titleEn: GPT-6.1 Terra halves OpenAI's API prices and still gains ground on its larger models
OpenAI.titleKo: GPT-6.1 Terra는 OpenAI의 API 가격을 절반으로 낮추고 더 큰 모델에서 여전히 우위를 점하고 있음
OpenAI.summary:
Ad According to the system card , GPT-6.1 Terra holds up about as well as GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol against direct attacks on the instruction hierarchy , with those models hitting 99.99 percent on such tests.
Input tokens cost $1 per million, output tokens $5, compared to $2 and $10 for Claude Sonnet 5.5 and $2 and $12 for GPT-5.6 Terra.
On the scientific coding benchmark Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1, Terra outperforms GPT-6.1 Sol at lower cost and comes within five points of Claude Opus 5.5 at less than a fifth of the estimated cost.

On the scientific coding benchmark Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1, Terra outperforms GPT-6.1 Sol at lower cost and comes within five points of Claude Opus 5.5 at less than a fifth of the estimated cost.
summaryLinesKo: 광고 시스템 카드에 따르면 GPT-6.1 Terra는 명령 계층 구조에 대한 직접 공격에 대해 GPT-6 Astra 및 GPT-6.1 Sol과 비슷한 수준을 유지하며 해당 모델은 해당 테스트에서 99.99%를 기록함
Claude Sonnet 5.5의 경우 2달러, 10달러, GPT-5.6 Terra의 경우 2달러, 12달러인 것과 비교하여 입력 토큰은 백만 달러당 1달러, 출력 토큰은 5달러임
과학 코딩 벤치마크 Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1에서 Terra는 저렴한 비용으로 GPT-6.1 Sol보다 성능이 뛰어나며 예상 비용의 5분의 1 미만으로 Claude Opus 5.5의 5점 이내임

OpenAI.summary:
Figure 2: Turn 1 saves the prompt prefix up to the breakpoint, and turn 2 reuses it and pays full price only for the new question For agentic workloads, implicit caching lets Bedrock choose what to cache as the conversation grows.
GPT-6 Astra tied for the best implicit result in this six-turn workload: about 62 percent lower input cost than running without caching.
Along the way, I show you how prompt caching keeps costs down and keeps agents responsive and consistent.

OpenAI.summary:
A new study found that when forced to choose in this year’s upcoming midterm elections, SpaceXAI’s Grok 4.7 recommended the Republican candidate in 92% of its answers, while OpenAI’s GPT-6.1 Sol picked the Democrat in 97%.
Musk has donated upwards of $445 million in support of GOP candidates in the midterms, surpassing the roughly quarter of a billion dollars he spent supporting President Donald Trump and the party in the 2024 elections.
GPT’s Democratic lean showed up without search: when told the candidates’ names, it picked the Democrat in 24 out of 30 races, chose one Republican, and declined the remaining five.

SpaceX.title: Grok releases the first seven minutes of its AI-generated ‘Odyssey’
SpaceX.titleEn: Grok releases the first seven minutes of its AI-generated ‘Odyssey’
SpaceX.summary:
And Nolan is, in many ways, a perfect foil for Musk — while SpaceX and Tesla CEO hypes up data centers in space and posts an unending stream of AI-generated content, Nolan has described himself as “a techno-skeptic ” and said that before AI, he’d never seen a technology “so completely rejected by the public.”
Musk had previously lashed out at Christopher Nolan’s version of “The Odyssey” because Nolan cast nonwhite and transgender actors.
Three months after Elon Musk declared that Grok would release a full-length, “historically accurate” movie version of “The Odyssey,” Grok has published a whole seven minutes — what the company is now calling “Episode 1 of our Odyssey series.”

Databricks.summary:
Success depends on choosing the right entry point and managing the transition period effectively.
This guide outlines a migration framework across three pillars – Process, Technology, and People – for navigating that transition with minimal disruption and measurable business impact.
Profile the BigQuery estate first — datasets, query history and slot consumption — to find which workloads drive cost, which dashboards are actually used, and which tables are never queried at all.

Databricks Free Edition is a perpetually free version of the platform; each student signs up individually and works entirely in the browser, so a course can adopt it without provisioning servers or purchasing anything.
One platform can support an entire data + AI curriculum , from introductory data science and statistics through data engineering, BI, machine learning, AI, and capstone projects.
The barriers that often make industry platforms difficult to bring into the classroom, including cost, licensing, and IT provisioning, are solved by Databricks Free Edition; a permanently free account with no credit card, no cloud contract, and nothing to install.

Sierra AI.title: 𝜏³-Bench: Advancing agent evaluation to knowledge and voice
Sierra AI.titleEn: 𝜏³-Bench: Advancing agent evaluation to knowledge and voice
Sierra AI.titleKo: 𝜏³-벤치 · 상담사 평가를 지식과 음성으로 발전
Sierra AI.summary:
The headline comparison is non‑reasoning text models versus voice agents in realistic conditions: under ideal conditions (no interruptions or audio effects) the best voice agents get close to non‑reasoning text models (~54% vs 31–51% clean voice), but once you introduce realistic audio and turn‑taking the gap widens substantially (~54% vs 26–38% realistic voice).
Voice agents need to handle all of this while still completing real tasks: looking up orders, updating accounts, booking flights.
To test this, 𝜏-Knowledge introduces 𝜏-Banking, a fintech-inspired customer support domain built around a realistic knowledge base of 698 documents across 21 product categories (~195K tokens).

Voice agents need to handle all of this while still completing real tasks: looking up orders, updating accounts, booking flights.
To test this, 𝜏-Knowledge introduces 𝜏-Banking, a fintech-inspired customer support domain built around a realistic knowledge base of 698 documents across 21 product categories (~195K tokens).
summaryLinesKo: 헤드라인 비교는 현실적인 조건의 비추리 텍스트 모델과 음성 에이전트임 · 이상적인 조건(중단 또는 오디오 효과 없음)에서는 최고의 음성 에이전트가 비추리 텍스트 모델에 가까워지지만(~54% 대 31~51% 깨끗한 음성), 일단 사실적인 오디오를 도입하고 차례대로 진행하면 격차가 상당히 넓어집니다(~54% 대 26~38% 사실적인 음성)
음성 에이전트는 주문 조회, 계정 업데이트, 항공편 예약 등 실제 작업을 완료하는 동시에 이 모든 것을 처리해야 함
이를 테스트하기 위해 𝜏-Knowledge는 21개 제품 카테고리(~195,000개 토큰)에 걸쳐 698개 문서의 현실적인 지식 기반을 기반으로 구축된 핀테크에서 영감을 받은 고객 지원 도메인인 𝜏-Banking을 도입함

Sierra AI.title: AI-native product localization
Sierra AI.summary:
Sierra — 4 months, 2 initial locales (Spanish and Japanese) with 4 more to come While I still relied on native speakers, internal dogfooding, and human review for translation quality, language nuance, and overall UX correctness, fewer human eyes meant fewer Q&A catches — that’s a real tradeoff.
This improved throughput immediately, but introduced a new problem: tracking mistakes at scale.
Historically, with projects like this you need to divide work, synchronize migrations, coordinate reviews, and manage QA across teams.

Hugging Face.title: Can we trust LLMs to judge whether a research idea is novel?
Hugging Face.titleEn: Can we trust LLMs to judge whether a research idea is novel?
Hugging Face.titleKo: 연구 아이디어가 참신한지 판단하는 데 LLM을 신뢰할 수 있습니까
Hugging Face.summary:
By comparison, Idea Novelty Checker, a literature-grounded retrieval and reranking pipeline, scored 0.642 at $30.66, while Sakana AI’s AI Scientist, whose novelty evaluator iteratively searches Semantic Scholar, scored 0.772 at $82.05.
We saw substantial shifts on the Human-Only dataset as well; the same change moved Claude Opus 4.6 accuracy by 21 points.
On the Human+Generated set, a simple Claude Opus 4.6 prompt using low reasoning and majority voting across three calls achieved 0.854 macro-F1 at a total evaluation cost of $2.59.

We saw substantial shifts on the Human-Only dataset as well; the same change moved Claude Opus 4.6 accuracy by 21 points.

Hugging Face.title: LitPivot: Developing research ideas through dynamic contextualization within the literature landscape
Hugging Face.titleEn: LitPivot: Developing research ideas through dynamic contextualization within the literature landscape
Hugging Face.titleKo: LitPivot: 문학 환경 내에서 역동적인 맥락화를 통해 연구 아이디어 개발
Hugging Face.summary:
In our analysis of meeting notes from four completed computer science research projects, we identified 21 literature-initiated pivots across all four projects.
These studies suggest that LitPivot can support both early exploration and the refinement of an existing research direction.
In a study with 17 researchers, domain experts rated research ideas developed with LitPivot as better grounded in the literature than those developed with a text editor and an AI chat tool.

Hugging Face.titleEn: Hugging Face’s New AI Biology Model Lets You Chat With DNA
Hugging Face.titleKo: Hugging Face의 새로운 AI 생물학 모델로 DNA와 대화 가능
Hugging Face.summary:
Researchers face restrictions when it comes to uploading identifiable or sensitive patient data to frontier AI models, so Tunstall says his team intentionally designed a small model with 14 billion parameters.
The team started with an existing language model and expanded its vocabulary to read DNA in groups of six letters.
Lewis Tunstall, a senior research scientist at Hugging Face, says the tool is meant to help researchers design new drugs and genetic therapies, and it could potentially aid patients in interpreting their own genomes.

Hugging Face.titleEn: OlmoEarth v1.3: State-of-the-art embeddings for the whole planet
Hugging Face.titleKo: OlmoEarth v1.3: 지구 전체를 위한 최첨단 임베딩
Hugging Face.summary:
Compare each pixel's vector across years, no model training required, and the 2017 to 2020 pair lights up where the mining was spreading to the southeast.
If you wanted to reproduce it, pre-training OlmoEarth v1.3 Base would cost roughly $2,720 of rented H100 time for the final run.
Alongside OlmoEarth v1.3, we’re sharing precomputed, annual embeddings for the whole planet (10m, 64- and 128-dimensions), plus a new browser-based tool to explore and customize maps based on those embeddings — the OlmoEarth Embeddings Explorer .

Abridge.summary:
Conditions due for follow-up are in view before the visit starts, orders are staged before the patient leaves, and inpatient notes start from what the chart already holds.
This month, Visit Topics, In-Visit Orders, and Patient Visit Summary Editing with the Abridge Assistant help transform how clinicians prepare for a visit, capture orders throughout the conversation, and send patients home with a summary more easily tailored to them.
Much of the work that makes a visit or a hospital stay take longer than it should is reconstruction: keeping track of which conditions still need follow-up, entering orders after the patient has left, assembling an admission note from across the chart.

Writer.title: WRITER Gives Enterprises Control Over AI Detection with Invisible, Customer-Specific Watermarks
Writer.titleEn: WRITER Gives Enterprises Control Over AI Detection with Invisible, Customer-Specific Watermarks
Writer.titleKo: WRITER는 눈에 보이지 않는 고객별 워터마크를 통해 기업에 AI 탐지 제어 기능을 제공함
Writer.summary:
They want ownership, control, and configurability, right down to how and when their AI-generated content is watermarked,” said May Habib, CEO and Co-founder of WRITER.
WRITER’s watermarking approach builds on its commitment to put enterprises in control of their AI decisions and outputs SAN FRANCISCO — October 27, 2026 — WRITER , the leading AI platform for enterprise growth, today introduced a new approach to text watermarking that gives enterprises ownership, control and choice over how their AI-generated text is identified and traced.
When enterprises enable watermarking, text generated by WRITER’s Palmyra models will carry an invisible, machine-readable mark specific to each customer’s organization.

샌프란시스코 — 2026년 10월 27일 — 기업 성장을 위한 선도적인 AI 플랫폼인 WRITER는 오늘 기업이 AI 생성 텍스트를 식별하고 추적하는 방법에 대한 소유권, 제어 및 선택권을 제공하는 텍스트 워터마킹에 대한 새로운 접근 방식을 도입함

Writer.title: The frontier of enterprise growth
Writer.summary:
What BetterHelp learned about AI that most marketing teams haven't WRITER Launches AI CMO Council to Lead the Agentic Marketing Revolution in the Enterprise Leading from the front: How BetterHelp’s Chief Growth Officer is building an AI-native marketing engine WRITER scores highest in capabilities in 2026 IDC MarketScape for Agentic Marketing Monthly dispatches on the AI revolution.
Years before chatbots made headlines, co-founders May Habib and Waseem Alshikh saw what AI could do for marketing at enterprise scale and built a company grounded in both the technology and craft of growth, with systems designed for work that demands brand precision, business context, and fiduciary-grade governance.
Command-line interfaces, system prompts, and a fifty-line markup file to describe your entire brand are the native language of a developer, not the people working to grow revenue and protect an enterprise’s reputation built across decades.

Writer.title: The three pillars of AI-native marketing: Why productivity is just the baseline
Writer.titleEn: The three pillars of AI-native marketing: Why productivity is just the baseline
Writer.titleKo: AI 기반 마케팅의 세 가지 기둥 · 생산성이 단지 기준일 뿐인 이유
Writer.summary:
Only 5% of organizations have reached super-user status with 5X productivity gains; the remaining 95% have deployed AI but haven’t achieved compounding returns.
How buyers discover and learn about brands and products has fundamentally shifted, and most marketing teams haven’t caught up.
The Total Economic Impact™ study commissioned by Forrester Consulting on behalf of WRITER found that the composite organization achieved a 333% ROI with a payback period of under 6 months.

Writer.titleEn: When AI scales what's already broken: Lisa Gately, Principal Analyst at Forrester
Writer.titleKo: AI가 이미 손상된 부분을 확장할 때 · Lisa Gately, Forrester 수석 분석가
Writer.summary:
That’s Lisa Gately: not a junior marketer, not a frustrated copywriter, but a principal analyst at Forrester who spent more than 20 years building content systems inside tech companies before she crossed over to study them.
The teams thriving in the shift to AI-driven marketing share a few traits, Lisa notes.
When the CMO-CFO conversation is only about productivity and cost-cutting, it’s hard to justify new investment.

Writer.title: What every Medical Affairs leader needs to know about generative AI in pharma
Writer.titleEn: What every Medical Affairs leader needs to know about generative AI in pharma
Writer.titleKo: 제약 분야의 생성 AI에 대해 모든 의료 업무 리더가 알아야 할 사항
Writer.summary:
The insights they share will provide the answers you’re seeking and inspire you to implement AI within your organization: Rob Stevens , 20-year veteran in the pharma industry, including former Global Head, Digital Medical Affairs at Novartis Zayed Yasin , MD, healthcare industry lead at WRITER and practicing ER physician The main challenge with generative AI in pharma is figuring out how to strike the right balance.
Delivering information when it’s most needed amplifies its impact — which is exactly where generative AI can make up for lost time.
Every industry is buzzing about generative AI’s potential, but Medical Affairs in pharma face unique challenges that demand tailored solutions.

Writer.title: From SEO to GEO: Why your keywords need a conversational upgrade
Writer.titleEn: From SEO to GEO: Why your keywords need a conversational upgrade
Writer.titleKo: SEO에서 GEO까지 · 키워드에 대화형 업그레이드가 필요한 이유
Writer.summary:
Basically, it turns your legacy SEO investment into GEO fuel without starting from scratch.
Traffic crisis accelerates: Publishers are experiencing traffic drops of 30-70% as users shift from traditional searche to conversational AI chatbots.
Keywords vs. conversations: Traditional SEO keywords like “hair loss treatment” fail in AI search because real people ask conversational questions like “I’m noticing my hairline receding—what treatments can stop this?”

DeepSeek.summary:
If the 100-billion-yuan scale of this round is added to the RMB 51 billion first-round financing finalized by Liang Wenfeng and core institutions at the end of June, DeepSeek has cumulatively absorbed more than RMB 1500 billion of capital in just over 100 days, setting a brand new record for capital throughput speed in the global artificial intelligence field .
In August this year, DeepSeek once launched a high-paying recruitment in the fields of game development and 3D rendering , which attracted widespread attention in the game industry.
Sources familiar with the matter revealed that the transaction underwent drastic dynamic adjustments during the promotion process: the initial planned fundraising amount was RMB 500 billion , then under the competition of industrial capital from all parties and existing shareholders, the target was raised twice , and the final financing amount directly doubled to the hundred-billion-yuan level .

His desire to open-source this project was partly why he left Meta and decided to go it alone.

Meta AI.summary:
Tesla driver using Full Self-Driving struck and killed a man crossing I-80 Trump says Sundar Pichai talked him out of renaming the Atlantic Ocean Bill Gates says to prepare for 20 years of ‘tumultuous’ AI disruption Video Sure, let’s smoosh SpaceX and Tesla together, who cares
Meta is delaying the enforcement of its new business terms after publishers raised concerns that they could allow the company to scrape news sites for AI training, as reported earlier by Fast Company .
The business terms , which were originally supposed to go into effect on October 30th, appeared to give Meta permission to freely scrape the new sites that use its platforms, while using the material for AI training.
